scopeNotes: The supplied real station account was used for login and read-only verification. Price, profile, PIN/password, dispensing, order and notification write flows used a separate QA station and test accounts.
Customer payment creation returned 403 for STATION. Payment lookup/checkout were checked with missing records and are not offered as station payment actions.
Public OTP verification returned 403 for station staff: password login is required. Driver registration remains outside station UI and was not executed in this verification run.

Order message retrieval succeeded. Marking messages read returned 403 for the station account. Sending to a cancelled order returned 409. The UI presents assigned-driver messaging subject to backend permission and keeps closed orders read-only.
Support creation/reply request validation returned 422; no unsolicited support conversation was opened. These forms are implemented with schema validation and confirmation.

Nine mutable QA resources were deactivated; test delivery orders were cancelled/rejected, authorizations completed, and test dispensing settled. The backend has no deletion API for private uploads, ledgers, audit records or fixture balances, so this history remains.
